description.zh:
返回信息的语言类型：

- zh-CN：中文
- en-US：英文
description.en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh-CN: Chinese

- en-US: English

description.zh:
是否配置钉钉报警通知：

- true：已配置，当报警事情发生时，会发送钉钉通知

- false：未配置
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable DingTalk notifications. Valid values:

- true: Enabled. When an alert is triggered, a DingTalk message is sent.

- false: Disabled.

description.zh:
是否配置邮件报警通知：

- true：已配置，当报警事情发生时，会发送邮件通知

- false：未配置
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable email notifications. Valid values:

- true: Enabled. When an alert is triggered, an email is sent.

- false: Disabled.

description.zh:
报警事件类型：

- addr_alert：地址不可用

- addr_resume：地址恢复可用

- addr_pool_unavailable：地址池不可用

- addr_pool_available：地址池恢复可用
description.en:
The type of alert event. Valid values:

- addr\_alert: The address is unavailable.

- addr\_resume: The address has recovered.

- addr\_pool\_unavailable: The address pool is unavailable.

- addr\_pool\_available: The address pool has recovered.

description.zh:
是否配置短信报警通知：

- true：已配置，当报警事情发生时，会发送短信通知

- false：未配置

仅中国站支持短信通知，国际站不支持短信通知。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable text message notifications. Valid values:

- true: Enabled. When an alert is triggered, a text message is sent.

- false: Disabled.

Note: Text message notifications are supported only on the China site (aliyun.com).
A list of alert notification groups.

description.zh:
实例告警配置模式：

- global：继承全局报警配置，即实例采用全局告警配置

- instance_config：自定义报警配置
description.en:
The alert configuration mode for the instance. Valid values:

- global: The instance inherits the global alert configuration.

- instance\_config: The instance uses a custom alert configuration.

description.zh: 用户生成的请求token。用于保证请求的幂等性。注意  由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: A client-generated token that ensures the idempotence of the request. The client must generate a unique value for this parameter. The token can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters.

description.zh: 域名实例配置id，相同接入域名、相同的GTM实例可以同时配置A和AAAA记录，此情况下相同的GTM实例会出现2个域名实例配置，ConfigId可以唯一标识域名实例配置。
description.en: The ID of the domain name instance configuration. A GTM instance can have two configurations for the same access domain name if you configure both A and AAAA records. The ConfigId uniquely identifies a configuration.
The ID of the Global Traffic Manager (GTM) 3.0 instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns update-cloud-gtm-instance-config-alert --accept-language zh-CN --client-token 1ae05db4-10e7-11ef-b126-00163e240022 --instance-id gtm-cn-zz11t58000s --config-id Config-0000011 --alert-mode global --alert-group 云账号报警联系人 --alert-config EmailNotice=true NoticeType=addr_alert SmsNotice=true DingtalkNotice=true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns UpdateCloudGtmInstanceConfigAlert --region cn-hangzhou --AlertGroup '["云账号报警联系人"]' --AlertConfig '[{"EmailNotice":true,"NoticeType":"addr_alert","SmsNotice":true,"DingtalkNotice":true}]' --InstanceId 'gtm-cn-zz11t58000s' --AcceptLanguage 'zh-CN' --ConfigId 'Config-0000011' --AlertMode global --ClientToken '1ae05db4-10e7-11ef-b126-00163e240022'
